name: Disable Consumer Experience
description: Disables Microsoft consumer experiences that display app recommendations, promotional content, and membership notifications while keeping the Store functional.

description_i18n.en: Disables Microsoft consumer experiences that display app recommendations, promotional content, and membership notifications while keeping the Store functional.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Microsoft-Anwenderfeatures für App-Empfehlungen und Werbung bei laufendem Microsoft Store.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les expériences grand public de Microsoft pour cacher les recommandations et la publicité tout en gardant le Store.

warnings.title: Edition compatibility note
warnings.message: This policy is officially supported on Windows Enterprise, Education, and IoT editions. Home or Pro versions may ignore some settings after applying the tweak

warnings.title: Existing apps remain installed
warnings.message: This change only prevents future app recommendations and automatic provisioning. Applications already on your system are not removed by this tweak

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Configures the DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures DWORD value under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent to 1 Also sets ContentDeliveryAllowed and SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled to 0 in HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager
